description: This file defines a TreeView node class called TextNode, which extends the base Node class. It manages label setup, rendering HTML for the node, and interaction styles within a tree view component in a web application.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TextNode
classes.description: A class representing a text node in a TreeView widget, containing methods for label setup, HTML rendering, and node interaction handling.

methods.name: setUpLabel(oData)
methods.description: Initializes the node's label and optional hyperlink target attributes based on provided data.

methods.name: getLabelEl()
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element corresponding to the label of the node.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Generates the HTML string for rendering this node within the tree, including toggle icons and labels with event handlers.
